task_title: fix: make CI recovery waiting and cleanup idempotent

plan_review.notes: Adopted explicit repository-label versus PR-attachment cleanup matrix; unexpired missing-label shepherd leases fail closed while matching release and expired leases may converge; both 404 cleanup orders are independently safe with ownership recheck. Direct waiting PRs are preserved before repair windowing and waiting markers remain until a terminal transition is persisted. Semantic no-op comparison ignores timestamps and non-behavioral waiting/empty-idle triggers; heartbeat forces persistence.
